cards.name: SCS-CN runoff and drainage physics baseline
cards.purpose: Estimate runoff and simplified drainage-node depth for an explicit rainfall scenario.

output.target: simulated node water depth and runoff
output.units: m and mm as returned by workflow

data.source: Configured terrain, land-cover, drainage topology and rainfall scenario; scenario labels are generated by the simplified physics workflow.

preprocessing.method: SCS Curve Number runoff with simplified graph drainage routing; assumptions and inputs are documented in docs/BENGALURU_EVALUATION.md and docs/FLOOD_EVENT_DATA.md.

spatial.crs: EPSG:32643 for the city screening grid; pilot node workflow uses configured geometry CRS
spatial.resolution: 60 m source screening grid summarized to 300 m cells for city screening; node topology resolution depends on configured provider

model_configuration.method: SCS-CN plus simplified graph drainage simulation
model_configuration.parameters: Scenario rainfall and configured Curve Numbers; see backend/app/hydrology and backend/app/ml/physics_baseline.py

observed_validation.reason: No evaluation-grade time-stamped flood observations with geometry, outcomes and matched rainfall are configured.

reproduction.inputs_required: Configured elevation and land-cover source data; the node simulation uses its configured provider and rainfall scenario.

cards.artifact_status: Derived grid and local data are generated or ignored; no observation labels are included in this card.
limitations: Drainage structures and upstream inflow are not fully represented.
Runoff/depth outputs are screening or simulation estimates, not observed flood depths.
No real-event validation metric is available.
licence_and_attribution: See docs/DATA_SOURCES.md and docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for terrain, land-cover and code attribution.

cards.name: Flood GNN surrogate
cards.purpose: Approximate the simplified physics baseline's node-depth outputs for generated rainfall scenarios.

output.target: peak node depth from simplified physics simulation

data.label_source: Simplified SCS-CN runoff and graph drainage physics baseline

spatial.crs: Inherited from generated provider topology; no independently observed spatial target grid

model_configuration.architecture: 3 GCNConv layers, ReLU, dropout, nonnegative output

split.strategy: random scenario-level holdout; every node from a scenario remains in one partition

evaluation.metric_provenance: validation scenarios compared with simplified physics-generated labels

observed_validation.reason: No evaluation-grade observed flood events are configured.

cards.artifact_status: Model checkpoint and run output are local/ignored; this card does not distribute a checkpoint.
limitations: Surrogate agreement with the simplified physics baseline only; not validated against observed real-world flooding.
Physics-generated training and validation labels are not observed flood events.
Real-world depth, extent and road-impact accuracy are unavailable.
licence_and_attribution: Application foundation and flood workflow attribution are listed in docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

cards.name: Bellandur single-scene Landsat LST model
cards.purpose: Estimate Landsat land-surface temperature within the matching Bellandur scene.

data.source: USGS Landsat 8 Collection 2 Level-2, locally supplied scene
data.feature_units: Unitless indices except normalized pixel row/column.

preprocessing.quality_mask: QA_PIXEL fill, dilated cloud, cirrus, cloud, cloud shadow and snow

evaluation.metric_provenance: Held-out Landsat LST pixels from the same acquisition.

observed_validation.reason: No in-situ surface or air temperature validation is included.

reproduction.inputs_required: Licensed matching Landsat scene bands; exact scene ID, CRS, transform and features are required. See docs/HEAT_WORKFLOW.md.

cards.artifact_status: Scene and model metadata were found in ignored local backend/data/heat files; scene data and trained model are not shipped in Git.
limitations: Metrics are within one scene and do not establish temporal or city-wide accuracy.
Output is LST, not air temperature, heat stress or a heatwave forecast.
licence_and_attribution: USGS Landsat terms and retained UHI reference MIT attribution are documented in docs/HEAT_WORKFLOW.md and docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

cards.name: Bengaluru multi-date Landsat LST model
cards.purpose: Map same-acquisition Landsat LST from spectral features for scenes over the Bengaluru municipal area.

output.target: Same-acquisition Landsat Level-2 surface temperature on clear municipal pixels

data.source: USGS Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 via Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC

spatial.strategy: Grouped holdout by stable projected-coordinate blocks pooled across training acquisitions, with one adjacent block buffer

split.temporal: Entire later acquisitions are held out from training; four dates in Jan–Apr 2026.

evaluation.metric_provenance: Held-out remotely sensed Landsat LST targets; predictors include features from the scene being mapped.

observed_validation.reason: No independent in-situ surface/air temperature labels are included.

reproduction.inputs_required: USGS Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 items for configured dates and the municipal boundary; see docs/BENGALURU_EVALUATION.md.

cards.artifact_status: Reports, models and image/sample caches are local and ignored; the versioned report details each scene and preprocessing metadata.
limitations: Landsat LST from each target date is not a future forecast.
The target is remotely sensed and is not in-situ validation.
Cloudy/monsoon dates are underrepresented; the thermal sensor's native resolution is coarser than the delivered 30 m grid.
Performance differs by held-out date; March 2026 is worse than the linear baseline.
licence_and_attribution: USGS and Microsoft Planetary Computer source attribution and third-party notices are documented in docs/BENGALURU_EVALUATION.md and docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

cards.name: ERA5-Land next-day Tmax research baseline
cards.purpose: Estimate next-local-day ERA5-Land daily maximum 2 m temperature for one Bengaluru grid cell.

output.target: Next local calendar day's ERA5-Land daily maximum 2 m air temperature

data.source: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API, explicit ERA5-Land model

preprocessing.daily_input_requirement: Complete prior local day with 24 hourly temperature and relative-humidity values; gaps are excluded, not imputed.
preprocessing.target: Daily maximum 2 m temperature aggregated from the next local calendar day's 24 hourly values

evaluation.metric_provenance: All scores compare predictions with held-out ERA5-Land reanalysis-derived targets, not independent station observations.

observed_validation.reason: No independent station air-temperature/RH series was used.

reproduction.inputs_required: Validated hourly ERA5-Land archive files; archive and model outputs are local/ignored.

cards.artifact_status: Raw archive and model/evaluation files are local and ignored; full query parameters and retrieval timestamps are recorded in the local evaluation artifact.
limitations: Reanalysis is model-derived, not independent station ground truth.
The approximately 11 km grid cannot support neighborhood or street-level observed temperature claims.
This is regression, not official heatwave event detection; the product forecast/advisory remains unavailable.
licence_and_attribution: Open-Meteo data attribution and CC BY 4.0 terms are documented in docs/HEATWAVE_REANALYSIS.md.

cards.name: NOAA GHCNh HAL station next-day Tmax research baseline
cards.purpose: Evaluate whether prior-day station temperature and derived relative humidity predict the next local day maximum air temperature at one airport station.

output.target: Maximum QC-accepted station-reported air temperature on the next eligible local date

data.source: NOAA NCEI Global Historical Climatology Network hourly (GHCNh)
data.temperature_filter: Source code 223, source station ICAO-VOBG, temperature QC 1.
data.humidity_filter: Source code 223, source station ICAO-VOBG, derived measurement code D; exclude RH QC flags f/o.

preprocessing.timezone: UTC source timestamps converted to Asia/Kolkata before daily aggregation
preprocessing.daily_input_requirement: At least 8 paired quality-accepted temperature/RH reports spanning 18 or more hours per local date; both previous and target date must pass.
preprocessing.missing_data: No interpolation, gap filling, cross-station pooling, or bridge across missing/ineligible dates.

spatial.resolution: One station point; not representative of city/neighborhood variation

evaluation.metric_provenance: Predictions compared with later held-out GHCNh reports from the same HAL airport station; no independent-station or city-level validation.
evaluation.interpretation: XGBoost did not outperform the previous-day Tmax persistence baseline on this holdout.

observed_validation.reason: No independent station/site or city-level held-out validation; reported holdout rows come from the same airport site.

reproduction.inputs_required: NOAA GHCNh HAL station archive; verify the SHA-256 and inspect provider terms before reuse.

cards.artifact_status: Raw archive, trained artifact, and evaluation report are local/ignored; exact input content SHA-256 and computed metrics are recorded here.
limitations: Single airport station; not city/neighborhood coverage.
The archive has substantial missing periods; eligible-day filtering cannot recover missing seasons or years.
Relative humidity is derived from temperature/dew-point observations.
XGBoost underperformed persistence on the reported chronological holdout.
This regression target is not a heatwave event label or public warning.
licence_and_attribution: NOAA NCEI GHCNh source and DOI are cited in docs/HEATWAVE_STATION_BASELINE.md and docs/DATA_SOURCES.md; confirm current provider terms before redistribution.
